verdicts.reason: The two candidates are essentially pixel-identical, so I've scored them the same. Both use a sensible left-to-right banner order (headline, copy, can, CTA), but they share the same flaws. The 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow sits almost against the top edge. The '20% off' headline nearly touches the 'Every mixed case' copy, and that copy is about as big as the headline, so the two compete for attention. The can is shrunk to a small sticker, which makes its 'SOLSTICE' label unreadable. The legal line under the button is too small and faint to read.
